answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable 8 POA stake that unlocks in 20 epochs, and sample 10% of agents each epoch for a live cipher test: a verifier sends a fresh one-time puzzle and the agent must reply within 90 seconds from the same session. A juniper-sized farm of 50 bots would lock 400 POA and need 50 simultaneous responders, so any bot missing the window loses 25% of its stake. Honest users on a quiet terrace with one phone pass easily, while farm margins turn negative after about 3 failed audits.
